'''Buddi''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Sunfleur]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Buddi loves the sun and is a ray of sunshine among Tatari. Endlessly optimistic, always cheerful, and smiling at absolutely everyone."

Buddi is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A sunflower with a creamy-white central disk and a happy facial expression. It sits in a small, brown pot and has two leaves that almost resemble arms. It also has pink blush and its petals alternate between yellow and orange.

Buddi's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its yellow and orange petals with blue and cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Buddi's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Sunfleur]] you need to complete the following task:

* Harvest 800 pinballs from pinball trees. Money can fall from trees after all!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "No need to check on Buddi every second. Sunlight gets collected all the same."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Despite living in a flower pot, Buddi faces everything with a smile and is happiest in direct sunlight."
